Basically, the nuclear bombs were about as effective (more or less) than the average firebombing that was happening in every major (and even minor) city in Japan prior to the dropping of the nuclear bombs. The Japanese high command were no more concerned with the nuclear bombs that destroyed two cities than they were with the firebombs that destroyed all the rest of their cities.
